amharic: ከመጽደቁ በፊት የጅምር እና የዝጊያ ቀናት ያስፈልጋሉ።

english: Closing date must be after opening date.
amharic: የመዝጊያ ቀን ከመጀመሪያ ቀን በኋላ መሆን አለበት።

english: No approved establishment found for the selected position and organization.
amharic: ለተመረጠው የሥራ መደብ እና ተቋም የጸደቀ ምደባ አልተገኘም።

english: Only eligible employees in your scope are shown. Pending requests are excluded. Changing the type clears your selection.
amharic: በእርስዎ ወሰን ውስጥ ያሉ ብቁ ሠራተኞች ብቻ ይታያሉ። በመጠባበቅ ላይ ጥያቄ ያላቸው አይካተቱም። ዓይነቱን ሲቀይሩ ምርጫው ይጸዳል።

english: New: employees with no previous card.
amharic: አዲስ፦ ከዚህ በፊት ካርድ ያልነበራቸው ሠራተኞች።

english: Renewal: employees whose latest card has expired status.
amharic: እድሳት፦ የመጨረሻው ካርድ ሁኔታ ጊዜው ያለፈበት የሆነ።

english: Lost: employees whose latest card is reported lost.
Damaged: employees whose latest card is reported damaged.
Replacement: latest card is lost, damaged, revoked, expired or suspended.
amharic: ምትክ፦ የመጨረሻው ካርድ የጠፋ፣ የተበላሸ፣ የተሻረ፣ ጊዜው ያለፈበት ወይም የታገደ ነው።

english: Correction: latest card is flagged for reprint and is active, issued, printed, suspended or revoked.
amharic: ማስተካከያ፦ የመጨረሻው ካርድ ዳግም ሕትመት የሚፈልግና ንቁ፣ የተሰጠ፣ የታተመ፣ የታገደ ወይም የተሻረ ነው።

english: Choose employees and submit their card requests together.
amharic: ሠራተኞችን መርጠው የካርድ ጥያቄዎቻቸውን በአንድ ጊዜ ያስገቡ።

english: Try another search or turn off the selected-only filter.
amharic: ሌላ ፍለጋ ይሞክሩ ወይም የተመረጡትን ብቻ የሚያሳየውን ማጣሪያ ያጥፉ።

english: Showing the first :count employees. Search by name, number or organization to find others.
amharic: የመጀመሪያዎቹ :count ሠራተኞች ብቻ ይታያሉ። ሌሎችን ለማግኘት በስም፣ በቁጥር ወይም በተቋም ይፈልጉ።

english: 500 employees selected. Submit this group before creating another.
amharic: 500 ሠራተኞች ተመርጠዋል። ሌላ ቡድን ከመፍጠርዎ በፊት ይህን ቡድን ያስገቡ።

english: Search by employee name, number or organization
amharic: በሠራተኛ ስም፣ ቁጥር ወይም ተቋም ይፈልጉ

english: Select up to 500 employees. The request type and reason apply to everyone selected. If any employee cannot be submitted, no requests will be created.
amharic: እስከ 500 ሠራተኞች ይምረጡ። የጥያቄው ዓይነትና ምክንያት ለሁሉም ይተገበራሉ። የአንድ ሠራተኛ ጥያቄ መላክ ካልተቻለ ምንም ጥያቄ አይፈጠርም።

english: Verify an employee ID card. The card holder must approve the check.
amharic: የሠራተኛ መታወቂያ ካርድ ያረጋግጡ። የካርዱ ባለቤት ማረጋገጫውን መፍቀድ አለበት።

english: Unable to start the camera. Enter the card token below instead.
amharic: ካሜራውን ማስጀመር አልተቻለም። በምትኩ ከታች የካርድ ቶከኑን ያስገቡ።

english: Camera is off. Start it to scan a card QR code.
amharic: ካሜራው ጠፍቷል። የካርድ QR ኮድ ለመቃኘት ያስጀምሩት።

english: Camera permission was denied. Allow camera access, or enter the card token below.
amharic: የካሜራ ፈቃድ ተከልክሏል። የካሜራ መዳረሻ ይፍቀዱ፣ ወይም ከታች የካርድ ቶከኑን ያስገቡ።

english: No camera was found on this device. Enter the card token below instead.
amharic: በዚህ መሣሪያ ላይ ካሜራ አልተገኘም። በምትኩ ከታች የካርድ ቶከኑን ያስገቡ።

english: The camera is being used by another application. Close it and try again.
amharic: ካሜራው በሌላ መተግበሪያ እየተጠቀመ ነው። ዘግተው እንደገና ይሞክሩ።

english: Camera scanning needs a secure (https) connection. Enter the card token below instead.
amharic: የQR ቅኝት ደህንነቱ የተጠበቀ (https) ግንኙነት ይፈልጋል። በምትኩ ከታች የካርድ ቶከኑን ያስገቡ።

english: This browser cannot use the camera. Open this page in Chrome or Safari, or enter the card token below.
amharic: ይህ ብሮውዘር ካሜራ መጠቀም አይችልም። ገጹን በChrome ወይም በSafari ይክፈቱ፣ ወይም ከታች የካርድ ቶከኑን ያስገቡ።

english: The camera does not work in this app's built-in browser. Open the page in Chrome or Safari (menu → Open in browser), or enter the card token below.
amharic: ካሜራው በዚህ መተግበሪያ ውስጣዊ ብሮውዘር ውስጥ አይሰራም። ገጹን በChrome ወይም በSafari ይክፈቱ (ሜኑ → በብሮውዘር ክፈት)፣ ወይም ከታች የካርድ ቶከኑን ያስገቡ።

english: The camera scanner could not be loaded. Enter the card token below instead.
amharic: የካሜራ ስካነሩን መጫን አልተቻለም። በምትኩ ከታች የካርድ ቶከኑን ያስገቡ።

english: Card detected. Send OTP to verify.
Employee details are shown only after the card holder approves the check.
amharic: የሠራተኛው ዝርዝር የሚታየው የካርዱ ባለቤት ማረጋገጫውን ሲፈቅድ ብቻ ነው።

english: OTP sent to the employee’s registered email and phone
amharic: ኮዱ ወደ ሠራተኛው የተመዘገበ ኢሜይልና ስልክ ተልኳል

english: Too many requests. Please wait and try again.
amharic: በጣም ብዙ ጥያቄዎች። እባክዎ ቆይተው ይሞክሩ።

english: Employee is not eligible for this request type or already has a pending request. Refresh the list and check the card status.
amharic: ሠራተኛው ለዚህ የጥያቄ ዓይነት ብቁ አይደለም ወይም በመጠባበቅ ላይ ያለ ጥያቄ አለው። ዝርዝሩን ያድሱና የካርዱን ሁኔታ ያረጋግጡ።

english: Card request approved. Card is now pending print.
amharic: የካርድ ጥያቄ ጸድቋል። ካርዱ ለሕትመት ዝግጁ ነው።

english: Batch marked as printed. Cards are now ready for issuance.
amharic: ቡድኑ እንደታተመ ተመዝግቧል። ካርዶቹ አሁን ለማቅረብ ዝግጁ ናቸው።

english: Batch marked as printed. Each card now needs its quality check.
amharic: ዙሩ እንደታተመ ተመዝግቧል። እያንዳንዱ ካርድ አሁን የጥራት ፍተሻ ያስፈልገዋል።

english: Print batch cancelled; its cards can go into another batch.
amharic: የሕትመት ዙሩ ተሰርዟል፤ ካርዶቹ ወደ ሌላ ዙር መግባት ይችላሉ።

english: The card passed the quality check and can be issued.
amharic: ካርዱ የጥራት ፍተሻውን አልፏል፤ ሊሰጥ ይችላል።

english: The card failed the quality check. Approve a reprint or revoke it.
amharic: ካርዱ የጥራት ፍተሻውን አላለፈም። ድጋሚ ሕትመት ያጽድቁ ወይም ይሰርዙት።

english: Reprint approved: the card can go into a print batch.
amharic: ድጋሚ ሕትመት ጸድቋል፤ ካርዱ ወደ ሕትመት ዙር መግባት ይችላል።

english: A credential was issued for the card.
The credential was replaced. The printed QR no longer verifies: reprint or replace the card.
amharic: የማረጋገጫ መለያው ተቀይሯል። የታተመው QR ከእንግዲህ አያረጋግጥም፤ ካርዱን እንደገና ያትሙ ወይም ይተኩ።

english: The template version is now the one new cards are printed with.
amharic: ይህ የቅጽ ስሪት አዳዲስ ካርዶች የሚታተሙበት ሆኗል።

english: Someone is verifying your employee ID card (:card). Share this code with them only if you requested the check:
amharic: አንድ ሰው የእርስዎን የሠራተኛ መታወቂያ ካርድ (:card) እያረጋገጠ ነው። ማረጋገጫውን እርስዎ ከጠየቁ ብቻ ይህን ኮድ ያካፍሉ፦
ይህ ኮድ በ:minutes ደቂቃዎች ውስጥ ጊዜው ያበቃል።

english: If you did not expect this, ignore this message and report it to your administrator. Your details were not shown.
amharic: ይህን ካልጠበቁ ይህን መልእክት ችላ ይበሉና ለአስተዳዳሪዎ ያሳውቁ። ዝርዝርዎ አልታየም።

english: ID card verification code: :code. Expires in :minutes minutes. Do not share unless you requested the check.
amharic: የመታወቂያ ካርድ ማረጋገጫ ኮድ፦ :code። በ:minutes ደቂቃዎች ያበቃል። ማረጋገጫውን ካልጠየቁ አያካፍሉ።

english: Your session has expired. Please log in again.
amharic: የክፍለ ጊዜዎ አብቅቷል። እባክዎ እንደገና ይግቡ።

english: Access denied. You do not have permission to perform this action.
amharic: መዳረሻ ተከልክሏል። ይህን ድርጊት ለማከናወን መብት የለዎትም።

english: Your organization scope does not include this record.
Too many attempts. Please wait before trying again.
amharic: ብዙ ሙከራዎች። እባክዎ ጠብቀው እንደገና ይሞክሩ።

english: Password must meet the minimum security requirements.
amharic: የሚስጥር ቃል ዝቅተኛ የደህንነት መስፈርቶችን ማሟላት አለበት።

english: Registration is disabled. User accounts are created by administrators.
amharic: ምዝገባ ተሰናክሏል። የተጠቃሚ መለያዎች በአስተዳዳሪዎች ብቻ ይፈጠራሉ።

english: Multi-factor authentication is required for your account.
Multi-factor authentication cannot be disabled for your role.
Please complete multi-factor authentication setup to continue.
amharic: ለመቀጠል እባክዎ የብዙ-ደረጃ ማረጋገጫ ቅንብርን ያጠናቅቁ።

english: Please verify your authentication code to continue.
Save these recovery codes in a safe place. Each code can only be used once.
amharic: እነዚህን የመልሶ ማግኛ ኮዶች በደህንነቱ በተጠበቀ ቦታ ያስቀምጡ። እያንዳንዱ ኮድ አንድ ጊዜ ብቻ ይጠቀምበት ይችላል።

english: The file type is not permitted. Only allowed types may be uploaded.
amharic: የፋይሉ ዓይነት አይፈቀድም። የተፈቀዱ ዓይነቶች ብቻ መጫን ይቻላል።

english: Rate limit exceeded. Please wait and try again.
amharic: የጥያቄ ገደቡ ተሻገረ። እባክዎ ጥቂት ጠብቀው እንደገና ይሞክሩ።

english: Sensitive information is protected and cannot be disclosed.
amharic: ሚስጥራዊ መረጃ ተጠብቋል እና ሊወጣ አይችልም።

english: Your organization scope does not include this record.
This action is not permitted for your account.
A secure configuration is required for this environment.
amharic: ለዚህ አካባቢ ደህንነቱ የተጠበቀ ቅንብር ያስፈልጋል።

english: Invalid request. Please check your input and try again.

amharic: ሚናዎ ለማይሸፍነው አስቸኳይ ሥራ። ሌላ ሰው ያጸድቀዋል፤ በራሱ ይቋረጣል፤ በእሱ ስር የሚያደርጉት ሁሉ በኦዲት መዝገቡ ላይ ምልክት ይደረግበታል።

english: Audit rows are sealed every few minutes: each is chained to the one before and the range is signed; a sealed row can no longer change.
amharic: የኦዲት ረድፎች በጥቂት ደቂቃዎች ልዩነት ይታተማሉ፤ እያንዳንዱ ከቀዳሚው ጋር ይያያዛል፤ ክልሉም ይፈረማል፤ የታተመ ረድፍ ከዚያ በኋላ ሊቀየር አይችልም።

english: Requests waiting for a decision, grants in force and recent history.
amharic: ውሳኔ የሚጠባበቁ ጥያቄዎች፣ በሥራ ላይ ያሉ መዳረሻዎችና የቅርብ ጊዜ ታሪክ።

english: One organization and everything under it
What happened and why it cannot wait (at least 20 characters).
amharic: ምን እንደተከሰተና ለምን መጠበቅ እንደማይችል (ቢያንስ 20 ፊደላት)።

english: Versioned card layouts. A draft is edited and previewed with the renderer that prints; someone other than its author activates it, and the version active before is retired.
amharic: ስሪት ያላቸው የካርድ አቀማመጦች። ረቂቅ የሚታረመውና የሚታየው በሚያትመው መሳያ ነው፤ ከአዘጋጁ ውጭ ያለ ሰው ያነቃዋል፤ ከዚህ በፊት ንቁ የነበረው ስሪት ከአገልግሎት ይወጣል።

english: A retired version is kept: printed cards name it. Retiring the active version stops printing until another is activated.
amharic: ከአገልግሎት የወጣ ስሪት ይቀመጣል፤ የታተሙ ካርዶች ይጠቅሱታል። ንቁውን ስሪት ማውጣት ሌላ እስኪነቃ ድረስ ሕትመትን ያቆማል።

english: Someone other than the designer of this version activates it.
amharic: ይህን ስሪት የሚያነቃው ከአዘጋጁ ውጭ ያለ ሰው ነው።

english: Blank shows the city name from the ID card settings.
amharic: ባዶ ከሆነ ከመታወቂያ ካርድ ማስተካከያዎች የከተማውን ስም ያሳያል።

english: Drawn by the same renderer as the print sheet, with the template version this card was printed with (or the active one).
amharic: በሕትመት ገጹ መሳያ የተሳለ ነው፤ ካርዱ በታተመበት የቅጽ ስሪት (ወይም በንቁው) ይታያል።

english: The step is recorded in the audit log with what you write here.
amharic: እርምጃው እዚህ ከሚጽፉት ጋር በኦዲት መዝገቡ ይመዘገባል።

english: Suspended positions take no new placements. An abolished position must be empty first.
amharic: የታገዱ የሥራ መደቦች አዲስ ምደባ አይቀበሉም። የሚሰረዝ የሥራ መደብ መጀመሪያ ባዶ መሆን አለበት።

english: Why the status changes (at least 5 characters).
Organizations, positions, employees and placements from a file. Every row is checked with the Core's own rules; nothing is written until a second person approves.
amharic: ተቋማትን፣ የሥራ መደቦችን፣ ሠራተኞችንና የምደባ ለውጦችን ከፋይል ማስገባት። እያንዳንዱ ረድፍ በዋና መዝገቡ ደንቦች ይመረመራል፤ ሁለተኛ ሰው እስኪያጸድቅ ድረስ ምንም አይመዘገብም።

english: CSV or Excel (.xlsx), with the template's columns in the first row.
amharic: CSV ወይም Excel (.xlsx)፣ የቅጹ ዓምዶች በመጀመሪያው ረድፍ ላይ ሆነው።

english: The rows are waiting to be checked.
The import is waiting to be processed.
The file has too many rows; split it into several imports.
amharic: ፋይሉ በጣም ብዙ ረድፎች አሉት፤ ወደ ብዙ ገቢ ፋይሎች ይክፈሉት።

english: The file has no rows under its header.
amharic: ፋይሉ ከርዕሱ በታች ምንም ረድፍ የለውም።

english: The file could not be read; check that it is a CSV or .xlsx file from the template.
amharic: ፋይሉ ሊነበብ አልቻለም፤ ከቅጹ የተዘጋጀ CSV ወይም .xlsx ፋይል መሆኑን ያረጋግጡ።

english: Processing stopped; the rows written so far stay written and the rest can be imported again.
amharic: ሂደቱ ቆሟል፤ እስካሁን የተመዘገቡት ረድፎች ይቆያሉ፣ የቀሩትም እንደገና ሊገቡ ይችላሉ።

english: Open the hierarchy draft with the new organizations' parents
amharic: የአዲሶቹን ተቋማት የበላይ ተቋማት የያዘውን የተዋረድ ረቂቅ ይክፈቱ

english: The valid rows are written through the Core's rules, as you. Employees become drafts that still go through verification and approval.
amharic: ትክክለኛዎቹ ረድፎች በዋና መዝገቡ ደንቦች፣ በእርስዎ ስም ይመዘገባሉ። ሠራተኞች ረቂቅ ሆነው ማረጋገጫና ማጽደቅ ያልፋሉ።

english: :valid valid rows will be imported; :invalid invalid rows will not.
amharic: :valid ትክክለኛ ረድፎች ይገባሉ፤ :invalid ስህተት ያለባቸው ረድፎች አይገቡም።

english: I understand that the invalid rows are not imported; I will correct them and import them again.
amharic: ስህተት ያለባቸው ረድፎች እንደማይገቡ ተረድቻለሁ፤ አስተካክዬ እንደገና አስገባቸዋለሁ።

english: Nothing from it has been written; it is kept with your reason.
amharic: ከእሱ ምንም አልተመዘገበም፤ ከምክንያትዎ ጋር ይቀመጣል።

english: Records that may be the same person, side by side. Nothing is merged: a confirmed duplicate is blocked until a controlled merge.
amharic: አንድ ሰው ሊሆኑ የሚችሉ መዝገቦች ጎን ለጎን። ምንም አይዋሐድም፤ የተረጋገጠ ድግግሞሽ በቁጥጥር እስኪዋሐድ ድረስ ይታገዳል።

english: National ID on record for both
Someone other than the person whose change raised the match decides. A confirmed duplicate is blocked from verification, approval and cards.
amharic: ተመሳሳይነቱን ከፈጠረው ለውጥ ባለቤት ውጭ ሌላ ሰው ይወስናል። የተረጋገጠ ድግግሞሽ ከማረጋገጫ፣ ከማጽደቅና ከካርድ ይታገዳል።

english: What you checked and why you decided so (at least 5 characters).
The latest changes to organizations, positions, employees, assignments and cards, from the audit log.
amharic: በተቋማት፣ በሥራ መደቦች፣ በሠራተኞች፣ በምደባዎችና በካርዶች ላይ የተደረጉ የቅርብ ጊዜ ለውጦች፣ ከኦዲት መዝገብ።

english: Who holds which placement. Placements change through transfers and employment status, not from this list.
amharic: ማን የትኛውን ምደባ እንደያዘ። ምደባዎች የሚለወጡት በዝውውርና በሥራ ሁኔታ ነው እንጂ ከዚህ ዝርዝር አይደለም።

english: Placements appear here once employees in your organizations are assigned.
amharic: በተቋማትዎ ያሉ ሠራተኞች ሲመደቡ ምደባዎች እዚህ ይታያሉ።
ከእነዚህ ማጣሪያዎች ጋር የሚዛመድ ምደባ የለም

english: Partner applications and the change events sent to them. Secrets and tokens are never shown here.
amharic: የአጋር መተግበሪያዎችና ለእነርሱ የሚላኩ የለውጥ ክስተቶች። ሚስጥሮችና ቶከኖች እዚህ ፈጽሞ አይታዩም።

english: Register an application in API management to give a partner system access.
amharic: ለአጋር ሥርዓት መዳረሻ ለመስጠት በAPI አስተዳደር መተግበሪያ ይመዝግቡ።

english: API clients, webhooks and the change events sent to them. A secret is shown once, when it is created or rotated.
amharic: የAPI ደንበኞች፣ ዌብሁኮች እና የሚላኩላቸው የለውጥ ክስተቶች። ሚስጥራዊ ቁልፍ የሚታየው ሲፈጠር ወይም ሲቀየር አንድ ጊዜ ብቻ ነው።

english: Refused or failed calls in 24 hours
amharic: በ24 ሰዓት ውስጥ ውድቅ የሆኑ ወይም ያልተሳኩ ጥሪዎች

english: It is shown only this once. Store it in the partner system; if it is lost, rotate it.
amharic: የሚታየው በዚህ አንድ ጊዜ ብቻ ነው። በአጋር ሥርዓቱ ውስጥ ያስቀምጡት፤ ከጠፋ ይቀይሩት።

english: The client reads only the scopes and the part of the city chosen here. Its secret is shown once, after saving.
amharic: ደንበኛው የሚያነበው እዚህ የተመረጡትን ወሰኖች እና የከተማውን ክፍል ብቻ ነው። ሚስጥራዊ ቁልፉ ከተቀመጠ በኋላ አንድ ጊዜ ይታያል።

english: Register a client to give a partner system read access to the Core.
amharic: ለአጋር ሥርዓት ማዕከላዊ መዝገቡን የማንበብ ፈቃድ ለመስጠት ደንበኛ ይመዝግቡ።

english: Part of the city it reads
One IP address or range per line. Leave empty to allow any address.
amharic: በአንድ መስመር አንድ የአይፒ አድራሻ ወይም ክልል። ማንኛውንም አድራሻ ለመፍቀድ ባዶ ይተዉት።

english: Leave empty for one year from today.
amharic: ከዛሬ ጀምሮ ለአንድ ዓመት እንዲሆን ባዶ ይተዉት።

english: The current secret stops working at once. The new one is shown once.
amharic: አሁን ያለው ሚስጥራዊ ቁልፍ ወዲያውኑ መሥራት ያቆማል። አዲሱ አንድ ጊዜ ይታያል።

english: Its secret stops working at once and the client cannot be used again. Register a new client if access is needed later.
amharic: ሚስጥራዊ ቁልፉ ወዲያውኑ መሥራት ያቆማል፤ ደንበኛውንም ዳግመኛ መጠቀም አይቻልም። ወደፊት ፈቃድ ካስፈለገ አዲስ ደንበኛ ይመዝግቡ።

english: The Core sends the chosen events to this address, signed with a secret shown once after saving.
amharic: ማዕከላዊ መዝገቡ የተመረጡትን ክስተቶች ወደዚህ አድራሻ ይልካል፤ ከተቀመጠ በኋላ አንድ ጊዜ በሚታይ ሚስጥራዊ ቁልፍ ይፈረማሉ።

english: Register a webhook to send change events to a partner system.
amharic: የለውጥ ክስተቶችን ወደ አጋር ሥርዓት ለመላክ ዌብሁክ ይመዝግቡ።

english: Only events of this organization and everything under it are sent.
amharic: የሚላኩት የዚህ ተቋም እና ከሥሩ ያሉት ክስተቶች ብቻ ናቸው።

english: Deliveries are signed with the new secret from now on. It is shown once.
amharic: ከአሁን ጀምሮ መልእክቶች በአዲሱ ሚስጥራዊ ቁልፍ ይፈረማሉ። አንድ ጊዜ ይታያል።

english: Ready-made views of the audit trail, counted over the last :days days inside your organization scope.

amharic: የ:attribute መስክ ከእነዚህ ዓይነቶች አንዱ መሆን አለበት: :values።

english: The :attribute field is required when :values is present.
The :attribute must be a valid URL.
amharic: የ:attribute መስክ ትክክለኛ URL መሆን አለበት።

english: The :attribute must be a valid UUID.
amharic: የ:attribute መስክ ትክክለኛ UUID መሆን አለበት።

english: This position is no longer available. Please select another position.
amharic: ይህ የሥራ መደብ ከእንግዲህ ክፍት አይደለም። እባክዎ ሌላ የሥራ መደብ ይምረጡ።

english: Access denied outside your organization scope.
Enter a full https:// address without spaces.
amharic: ክፍተት የሌለው ሙሉ https:// አድራሻ ያስገቡ።

english: This page cannot be linked from the public site.
amharic: ይህን ገጽ ከሕዝብ ድረ-ገጹ ጋር ማገናኘት አይቻልም።

english: Employee :number was submitted for verification. Open the record to check it.
amharic: ሠራተኛ :number ለማረጋገጫ ቀርቧል። ለመፈተሽ መዝገቡን ይክፈቱ።

english: Employee :number was returned for correction. Open the record to see why.
amharic: ሠራተኛ :number ለእርማት ተመልሷል። ምክንያቱን ለማየት መዝገቡን ይክፈቱ።

english: Employee :number was verified and now needs approval by someone else.
amharic: ሠራተኛ :number ተረጋግጧል፤ አሁን በሌላ ሰው መጽደቅ አለበት።

english: Employee :number was approved; the first placement is active.
amharic: ሠራተኛ :number ጸድቋል፤ የመጀመሪያ ምደባው በሥራ ላይ ውሏል።

english: Hierarchy version :number was sent for review and approval.
Hierarchy version :number was approved and can be published.
Hierarchy version :number was published and is now the structure in force.
amharic: የተዋረድ ስሪት :number ታትሞ አሁን በሥራ ላይ ያለው መዋቅር ሆኗል።

english: The card request for employee :number was approved; the card is waiting to be printed.
amharic: ለሠራተኛ :number የቀረበው የካርድ ጥያቄ ጸድቋል፤ ካርዱ ሕትመት በመጠባበቅ ላይ ነው።

english: Card :number was printed. Someone other than its printer checks it before it is issued.
amharic: ካርድ :number ታትሟል። ከመሰጠቱ በፊት ከአታሚው ውጭ ያለ ሰው ይፈትሸዋል።

english: Card :number failed its quality check. Approve a reprint or revoke it.
amharic: ካርድ :number የጥራት ፍተሻውን አላለፈም። ድጋሚ ሕትመት ያጽድቁ ወይም ይሰርዙት።

english: Card :number passed its quality check and can be issued.
amharic: ካርድ :number የጥራት ፍተሻውን አልፏል፤ ሊሰጥ ይችላል።

english: Card :number expires on :until. Request a renewal in time.
amharic: ካርድ :number ጊዜው :until ያልፋል። እድሳት በጊዜ ይጠይቁ።

english: Card :number was suspended and does not verify until it is reinstated.
Card :number was revoked; it and its credential no longer verify.
amharic: ካርድ :number ተሰርዟል፤ ካርዱም ሆነ የማረጋገጫ መለያው ከእንግዲህ አያረጋግጡም።

english: The secret of the connected application :number was replaced. The old secret no longer works.
amharic: የተገናኘው መተግበሪያ :number ሚስጥር ተተክቷል። የቀድሞው ሚስጥር ከእንግዲህ አይሠራም።

english: The connected application :number was revoked and can no longer call the Core.
amharic: የተገናኘው መተግበሪያ :number ተሰርዟል፤ ከእንግዲህ ዋና መዝገቡን መጠየቅ አይችልም።

english: Webhook :number was suspended after repeated delivery failures. Its events wait until it is resumed.
amharic: ዌብሁክ :number በተደጋጋሚ መልእክት ባለመድረሱ ታግዷል። ክስተቶቹ እስኪመለስ ድረስ ይጠባበቃሉ።

english: Someone asked for emergency access. Open the Security Center to approve or refuse it.
amharic: አንድ ሰው የአደጋ ጊዜ መዳረሻ ጠይቋል። ለማጽደቅ ወይም ውድቅ ለማድረግ የደህንነት ማዕከሉን ይክፈቱ።

english: Your emergency access is in force until it ends by itself. Everything you do under it is marked in the audit trail.
amharic: የአደጋ ጊዜ መዳረሻዎ በራሱ እስኪቋረጥ ድረስ በሥራ ላይ ነው። በእሱ ስር የሚያደርጉት ሁሉ በኦዲት መዝገቡ ላይ ምልክት ይደረግበታል።

english: Your :number import finished. Open it to see the results.
amharic: የ:number ገቢ ፋይልዎ ተጠናቋል። ውጤቱን ለማየት ይክፈቱት።

english: Your :number import failed. Open it to see why.
amharic: የ:number ገቢ ፋይልዎ አልተሳካም። ምክንያቱን ለማየት ይክፈቱት።

english: The scan found critical issues (:check). Open Data Quality to work on them.
amharic: ፍተሻው አሳሳቢ ችግሮችን (:check) አግኝቷል። ለመከታተል የመረጃ ጥራት ገጹን ይክፈቱ።

english: A security event needs attention: open the Security Center.
amharic: ትኩረት የሚፈልግ የደህንነት ክስተት አለ፤ የደህንነት ማዕከሉን ይክፈቱ።
